# soccer_p1_inside attempt (MyoSoccerV3Skill inside 1, in_direct 1): the soccer_p1 champion's run-up, then the inside swing (hip turned out to its limit, abducted, knee bent, ankle locked up; hip flexor + adductor bursts) straight off the plant, the plant hip servoing the pelvis heading to in_yaw. Fails: the plant step leaves the pelvis turned ~0.6 rad toward the plant side, so the turned-out foot's inside faces left and the contact lands on its outside
